message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta.**  
Here’s how you can do it:

| Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Contact |
|------|------------|------------------------------|
| **1. Identify the source of the noise** | Determine whether it’s a residential, commercial, or industrial source. | — |
| **2. Gather evidence** | Take note of the time, duration, and nature of the noise. If possible, record audio or video. | — |
| **3. File a complaint with the City of Atlanta Police Department (APD)** | Call the APD’s non-emergency line at **404‑656‑4000** or use the online portal. | City of Atlanta Police Department – Non‑Emergency Line: 404‑656‑4000 |
| **4. Submit a formal noise complaint online** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website and fill out the “Noise Complaint” form. | [City of Atlanta Noise Control](https://www.atlantaga.gov/department/noise-control) |
| **5. Contact your local council member** | If you feel the issue isn’t being addressed, reach out to your elected council member. They can bring the matter up in council meetings or help facilitate a resolution. | City of Atlanta Council – Find Your Representative: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/council> |
| **6. Attend a public hearing (if necessary)** | For persistent or severe noise problems, the city may schedule a public hearing. You can request to attend or speak. | City of Atlanta Council – Public Hearing Schedule: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/council/public-hearings> |

### Quick Tips

- **Timing matters:** Noise complaints are most effective when reported promptly after the disturbance.
- **Documentation helps:** Having clear records of the noise incidents strengthens your case.
- **Follow up:** If you don’t receive a response within a reasonable timeframe, follow up with the APD or your council member.

### Additional Resources

- **Atlanta Police Department – Non‑Emergency Line:** 404‑656‑4000
- **City of Atlanta Noise Control Online Form:** <https://www.atlantaga.gov/department/noise-control>
- **Find Your Local Council Member:** <https://www.atlantaga.gov/council>

Feel free to let me know if you need help navigating any of these steps!
